text_block_list.text:
A quiet wind rolls over Tokyo
Racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан anticipates that Ines Fujin
might be
able to outrun everyone on the
long track, so
she's ready to give it her
all to keep pace.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On the other hand, Ines expects that
Ryan will
unmistakably catch up, giving
her extra
motivation to break away.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
This is the grand race where the front
runner, Ines
Fujin, and the chaser, Mejiro
Ryan, will collide!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
